sideB.summary: Deliver the Sample. Complete it when a player carrying the sample is in Johannesburg and Johannesburg has a supply center. This is the last Objective card. Completing it wins the game.
sideB.text:
Deliver the Sample.

This objective is completed when:
• a player carrying the sample is in Johannesburg,
AND
• Johannesburg has a supply center.

This is your last Objective card.
If you complete it, you win the game.
sideB.footer: This is your last Objective card. If you complete it, you win the game.

mechanics.whenRead: The mandatory objective enclosed by 12-03. Read during the first December setup draw and add it to the objective pool.
triggers: Win during play when both completion conditions are true
rules: Completed when a player carrying the sample is in Johannesburg AND Johannesburg has a supply center.
This is the last Objective card. Completing it wins the game.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective back and prints 12-04a. Side B text is vertical, with a red MANDATORY OBJECTIVE label. The card does not say how the sample is acquired. The journal 12-02 names Lake Baikal and the PEARL lab as the place it comes from.
